move.title: Take your ChatGPT history with you.
move.sub: Export it, drop the file in a browser tab, and carry on any conversation with the AI you choose: a free one, one on your computer, or your own Claude or Gemini. Keep ChatGPT or cancel it. Your history no longer ties you down.
keep.catch: Your work lives in this browser. Clear the browser’s data and it’s gone, unless you made a backup.
faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.items: Can I use it without signing up?
With the AI on this computer, yes. {free} asks for a free OpenRouter account.
Does it work with Excel and PDF files?
Yes, and with Word, PowerPoint, photos and whole folders. It hands back finished files too: a chart, a table, a document in Word.
Does it work on a phone, or offline?
On a phone, yes, in the browser. Offline, with the AI on this computer, which needs 12 GB of memory and a recent graphics chip: not on phones.
Can I use my ChatGPT or Claude plan?
Yes, and Copilot’s: {name} uses the plan you already pay for, through this computer. No second subscription.
Yes. Numbers are calculated rather than guessed, and under every answer it says where it was done. Check the words, as you would a colleague’s.
Can I use it at work?
If your company gives you no AI, it works as it is. If your computer is managed, ask your IT: {name} is deployed like a web page, behind your company’s gateway and sign-in.

No. There are no tracking cookies, and there never will be; in fact, no cookies at all. No analytics, no advertising, and no cookie banner, since there is nothing to agree to. Every change to {name} is checked, and refused if it sets a cookie.
